the question: “How can we learn to recognize the user’s state from a variety of data, in order to improve the user experience?

the development and application of machine learning methods for improving user state recognition in natural conditions.

we have demonstrated how multi-task and multi-view machine learning concepts can be applied to the problem of user state recognition, resulting in improved accuracy.

the two machine learning concepts can be used to improve the accuracy of user state recognition in a principled and effective way.
